verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships official, first-party SDKs. It documents error reporting libraries for over 50 platforms, and its official bugsnag-js repo covers browser, Node.js and React Native with framework plugins and a programmatic Bugsnag.notify() API. A community hands-on report corroborates that the client libraries are easy to integrate. missing for 10: no evidence of official SDKs or client libraries wrapping the Data Access API (only a raw OpenAPI spec), and no AI-native or agent-oriented SDK guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: BugSnag provides error reporting libraries for over 50 different platforms, listed in the navigation to the left.
Automatically detect JavaScript errors in the browser, Node.js and React Native, with plugins for React, Vue, Angular, Express, Restify and Koa.
Create your own session windows using the SDK API and get aggregated cpu and memory metrics(mean, min,max) for each one.
By chance they found client libraries for iOS, Ruby, Node and Android. The iOS library had a nice interface, would take minutes to add, and auto-reports fatal errors.
